Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up prototype 0004–0016 normal save through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Route 3 is converted after Brock’s Boulder Badge. Mt. Moon and Route 4 remain unconverted; avoid them for this checkpoint. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Route 3 has Yellow’s eight trainer teams, levels 9–14, explicit Yellow moves and complete battle dialogue. Grass has Spearow, Mankey, Sandshrew and Rattata at levels 8–12, with Yellow’s slot probabilities in every time period. HeartGold’s route geometry and warps are retained; inherited items and extra trainers are archived. The Pewter exit opens after Brock. All previous opening, item and museum changes carry forward. Blue team changes based on your Eevee’s evolution await your future plan. The bulk Rare Candy selector remains unfinished. Earlier downloads remain available separately.
